profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bloomberg
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
As a SWE at Bloomberg in NYC, my current work involves making builds faster by leveraging distributed systems.

I previously interned at Uber in San Francisco where I worked on LLMs for mobile testing.

I am a proud UCF honors college graduate passionate about mentoring and helping others. 

Feel free to reach out! ⚔️

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Played a key role in the early development of DragonCrawl, a project at Uber that uses large language models (LLMs) to accelerate and strengthen mobile testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Helped improve localization testing through a language processing model.

positions.title: Team Manager
positions.description: Worked coherently with other team managers to create scouting reports. Analyzed baseball data such as pitch type and velocity to determine player tendencies. Learned how to use different databases containing baseball statistics. Ran analytics Twitter account and worked on scouting and baseball data analysis.

positions.title: Outreach Lead
positions.description: Working as a lead to gather feedback from students in the club as well as reaching out to potential speakers to participate in events.

positions.title: Academic Committee Member
positions.description: Part of the committee under the Director of Academic Affairs. Help in planning events revolved around academics.

positions.title: UberSTAR SWE Intern
positions.description: Participated in a 12-week internship in which I got to learn about Uber's tools and work on an impactful project. The project used Flask, Python, HTML, CSS, and Javascript to create a full-stack application. This dashboard automated the triggering of a machine learning pipeline.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Worked on 2 Projects
1. Real-World Biomechanics Measurement and Analysis Suit
2. Wearable Feedback for Environmental Interpretation

volunteerExperiences.description: Organized and set up workshops for Take Stock in Children, a nonprofit with the goal of providing low-income students with mentors and scholarships.
Participated in the fundraising during the walk as well as helped in specific booths.
